# كنيسة القديسين مكسيموس ودوماديوس والقوي الأنبا موسى الأسود

> Church of Saints Maximus & Domadius and the Strong Anba Moussa the Black — a Coptic Orthodox church at the end of Street 45, El-Asafra Qebly, Alexandria, Egypt. This site is its public portal (Arabic first, English with `?lang=en`): mass times, meetings, activities, services, the church's story and how to reach it.

- Address: آخر شارع 45، العصافرة قبلي، قطاع المنتزه، الإسكندرية، مصر
- Telephone: +20 3 5368888
- The pages are rendered by a Flutter web app; facts change in the church's admin dashboard, so read the live pages for current times.

## Pages

- [الرئيسية — Home](https://maximos-domadios-church.web.app/): next mass, announcements, verse of the day, directory of sections
- [مواعيد القداسات — Mass schedule](https://maximos-domadios-church.web.app/mass-schedule): weekly liturgies and seasonal times
- [التربية الكنسية — Church education](https://maximos-domadios-church.web.app/church-education): Sunday school and meetings by age
- [الأنشطة — Church activities](https://maximos-domadios-church.web.app/church-activities): activities and services of the church
- [الخدمات العامة — Public services](https://maximos-domadios-church.web.app/public-services): public services offered by the church
- [عن الكنيسة — About](https://maximos-domadios-church.web.app/about): history, priests and the patron saints
- [تواصل معنا — Contact](https://maximos-domadios-church.web.app/contact): phone numbers, map, directions and the contact form
